director_findings: Adopt the independent residual-only review at ACCEPT 6 / REJECT 0.
All six candidates are eligible because their explicit second-class-applicable answer-defining propositions are absent from the 365-question canonical inventory; no numeric target is used.
C003 is accepted as the previously unrepresented aircraft-over-UAS right-of-way concept and source-defined rationale, not as a controlled scenario or reasoning variant of Q051/Q216/Q218.
IFR/VFR, sub-150m manned-aircraft cases, control area, control zone and the three basic airport restriction-surface purposes are likewise new answer-defining propositions in canonical inventory.
Future authoring remains residual-only: if a proposition is already answer-defining, a changed scenario, threshold or reasoning path does not make it eligible.
